title: Sync retries missing tables recreated under the same name without accepting partial data
steps: Run copy-load integration tests with a real local MariaDB, including a first-dump missing-table error while the list stays unchanged, a brief concurrent writer and a permanently invalid view.
expect: Both missing-table client error forms retry and load every site table plus all 400000 asset rows.
A briefly busy copy settles within the existing three tries.
An invalid view still stops with error 1356 and a redacted reason.
fence: Only a complete consistent copy can be accepted after a bounded retry; permanent view errors remain terminal.

tests: a table recreated under the same name retries a missing-table dump and loads every row
a copy busy for a few seconds after a chat turn loads once it settles; never a stop
a copy the server cannot read still stops, and says why with no name or value of the site
